title: Window run through a halted configuration
statement: Let $M$ be a Boolean-input Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $s$ be a natural-number window radius, and let $\mathrm{upd}$ be an update rule on an accumulator type $T$ and an optional Boolean. Suppose $\sigma$ assigns an accumulator to every Boolean word and satisfies $\sigma(u\mathbin{++}b)=\mathrm{upd}(\sigma(u),b)$ for every word $u$ and optional Boolean $b$, where appending an absent Boolean leaves $u$ unchanged. For every clock $N$, time $t$, and initial configuration $c$, if $t<N$, the run is halted at time $t$, and all configurations through time $t$ lie in the radius-$s$ window, then the window run with initial accumulator $\sigma$ of the initial output halts and returns the configuration at time $t$ together with accumulator $\sigma$ of its output.
